dockerfile:
FROM busybox:1.37
WORKDIR /www
COPY www/ /www/
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["httpd", "-f", "-v", "-p", "8080", "-h", "/www"]
explanation: This site is plain HTML in www/, so the Dockerfile copies it into a small busybox image and serves it with busybox's built-in httpd on port 8080. Nothing is built; check that every page lives under www/.
